tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Return the FeDeVi framework, the 2-week validation sprint loop, and the 'Five More' interview framework. Use this to ground answers about how to validate a startup idea correctly (customer discovery, interviews, risky assumptions, pilots) instead of inventing a generic framework.

tools.name: list_industry_templates
tools.description: Return Vouch's industry-specific validation starter templates (SaaS, AI, marketplaces, fintech, etc.) with target audience, common pain points, sample proof questions, and a deep link to start validating in that industry. tools.name: browse_public_gallery
tools.description: Search the Vouch public gallery of validated ideas that founders have chosen to share. Returns idea name, one-line description, target customer, and a link. Use when a user wants real examples of validated ideas, or to see how other founders framed a similar problem.

tools.name: start_validation
tools.description: Generate a one-click onboarding link that opens Vouch's /validate page pre-filled with the user's idea and target customer. tools.description: Return ready-to-post LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and newsletter blurbs a founder can copy-paste to announce what they learned validating an idea with Vouch. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_share_kit · Public sink: browse_public_gallery, get_share_kit · Destructive: start_validation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_share_kit · Public sink: browse_public_gallery, get_share_kit · Destructive: start_validation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
